an9.13:1.1: 13 athakho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
an9.13:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
an9.13:1.3: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ samparāyavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:2.1: kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ samparāyavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:3.1: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ sukhavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ dukkhavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:4.1: kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ dukkhavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ sukhavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:5.1: kinnukho āvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ paripakkavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ aparipakkavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:6.1: kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ aparipakkavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ paripakkavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:7.1: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ bahuvedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ appavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:8.1: kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ appavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ bahuvedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:9.1: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ vedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ avedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:10.1: kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ avedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ vedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:11.1: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ samparāyavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
an9.13:12.1: kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ samparāyavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi

an9.13:17.1: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ bahuvedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ appavedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
an9.13:18.1: kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ appavedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ bahuvedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
an9.13:19.1: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ vedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ avedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvuso vadesi
an9.13:20.1: kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta yaṃ kammaṃ avedaniyaṃ taṃ me kammaṃ vedaniyaṃ hotūti etassa atthāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti iti puṭṭho samāno no hidaṃ āvusoti vadesi
an9.13:20.2: atha kimatthaṃ caratāvuso bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
an9.13:21.1: yaṃ khossa āvuso aññātaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ appattaṃ asacchikataṃ anabhisametaṃ tassa ñāṇāya dassanāya pattiyā sacchikiriyāya abhisamayāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati
an9.13:21.5: ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti khossa āvuso ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti khossa āvuso
an9.13:21.6: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti khossa āvuso aññātaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ appattaṃ asacchikataṃ anabhisametaṃ
an9.13:21.7: tassa ñāṇāya dassanāya pattiyā sacchikiriyāya abhisamayāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati
an9.13:21.8: idaṃ khossa āvuso aññātaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ appattaṃ asacchikataṃ anabhisametaṃ
an9.13:21.9: tassa ñāṇāya dassanāya pattiyā sacchikiriyāya abhisamayāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
